DSP-00202 · TRP-00202 · filed 2026-07-25T08:47:11+08:00

No-show fee - My flight from Bangkok was delayed and by the time I got through immigration the driver had cancelled and I was charged $6.

No-show feeFiled by riderContested SGD 6.00Decided automatically - 172.9 s

Fee stands, driver compensated · driver compensation SGD 4.80 · decided by the panel · Why

The dispute

Rider's account, as filed

My flight from Bangkok was delayed and by the time I got through immigration the driver had cancelled and I was charged $6. I was in the terminal the whole time. I did not see any messages until later. Please waive the charge, this was not my fault.

The driver's account

I waited at T3 arrival Door 5 for over ten minutes and messaged twice with my plate number. Airport queue is 40 minutes, I lost the whole evening. The fee is fair.

Submitted by DRIVER at 2026-07-25T10:30:02+08:00

Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To the rider and to the driver: the $6.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00202 stands, and the driver is paid $4.80 of it. Here is why, and what it means for each of you.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.80 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

What each side argued

Rider advocate4 claim(s), 3 kept

  1. The rider's presence is undecidable on this record and must be treated as neutral, not as absence.

    Read the whole claim

    All 88 rider fixes in the trace report 45 to 80 m horizontal accuracy and are excluded by the same 25 m accuracy filter that POL-NS-04(c) applies as POL-NS-02 applies it to the driver, leaving rider_qualifying_fix_count at 0. Limb (c) therefore cannot be run, and under POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-11 an absent or fully filtered rider track is UNDECIDABLE - neither satisfied nor failed - so no finding may be built on the rider's own device. Nothing admissible places the rider away from the pickup, and the record cannot support a finding that he was elsewhere.

    EV-GPS-00202 · POL-NS-04, POL-NS-11

  2. The only artifacts capable of showing the rider was on notice are impaired, and I disclose the impairment rather than present the log as clean: EV-CHAT-00202 carries issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE at weight 0.85, and its payload confirms that the system arrival notice at 23:13:11 and both driver messages at 23:14:02 and 23:19:30 all carry read_at null.

    Read the whole claim

    Under POL-GEN-02(1) the log shows delivery, not receipt. The driver's account of a wait the rider saw and ignored rests on an artifact that cannot establish it, while the rider's account - that he saw no messages until later, being still inside the terminal after a delayed flight - is unrebutted on this bundle.

    EV-CHAT-00202, EV-TRIP-00202 · POL-GEN-02, POL-NS-04

  3. The driver's counterparty statement leans on an 'airport queue' of 40 minutes, but no advisory supports any kerbside condition at this pickup: EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING, carries no payload and weighs 0.0, and its absence is itself citable.

    Read the whole claim

    Under POL-NS-06 limb (i) the advisory must be present and populated, and a MISSING advisory makes that limb unavailable and cannot be asserted in support of the driver's account of conditions on the pickup road. The only element of the driver's account the record actually corroborates is the length of the wait itself.

    EV-ADVIS-00202-01, EV-TRIP-00202 · POL-NS-06Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-00202-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

  4. I do not press a dwell attack or a false-arrival attack, and I say so plainly rather than stretch them.

    Read the whole claim

    The derived arrival facts record run_count 1 and a single continuous in-geofence run of 620 seconds from 23:12:45 to 23:23:05, which is above the 480 second AIRPORT minimum, so POL-NS-06's shortfall route is not open to the rider; and the trace places the driver continuously inside the 150 m arrival radius with max_excursion_m null, so POL-NS-05's 300 m and 15 km/h triggers are not made out. The rider's case therefore rests on what the record leaves open - his undecidable presence and the driver's uncorroborated narrative - and not on the arithmetic of the dwell.

    EV-GPS-00202, EV-TRIP-00202 · POL-NS-01, POL-NS-05, POL-NS-06
Driver advocate10 claim(s), 8 kept

  1. Limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the driver's own evidence.

    Read the whole claim

    The free waiting period in force for this trip is 480 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, which agrees with fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec for the AIRPORT zone class). The trace, at a 10-second cadence with 100 percent coverage and no gaps (max_gap_sec 0.0), places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius for a single continuous qualifying run of 620 seconds - 63 qualifying fixes running from 2026-07-24T23:12:45+08:00 to 23:23:05+08:00. That is 140 seconds more than the policy requires, and the dwell is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as limb (c) directs, not from the arrival tap.

    EV-GPS-00202, EV-TRIP-00202 · POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02

  2. Limb (b) is satisfied.

    Read the whole claim

    The first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 23:12:45, 25 seconds before the trip record's 'arrived' event at 23:13:10 (derived.arrival.dwell_start_offset_sec = 25.0), so the trace places the driver inside the POL-NS-02 pickup geofence at or before the timestamp of that event. The AIRPORT radius is 150 m, and the driver's fixes qualify against it - the nearest fix in the whole driver track is 22.4 m from the pin.

    EV-GPS-00202, EV-TRIP-00202 · POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02

  3. Limb (d) is satisfied.

    Read the whole claim

    The trip record carries no boarding event and records a termination by the driver at 23:23:20 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three codes limb (d) recognises - and that termination falls after the 480-second required dwell, measured from the first qualifying fix at 23:12:45, had elapsed at 23:20:45. platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold has to be met. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold and the $6.00 fee is chargeable.

    EV-TRIP-00202, EV-GPS-00202 · POL-NS-01

  4. POL-NS-05 does not bite: the arrival marker is not false.

    Read the whole claim

    At the 23:13:10 marker the driver was inside his in-geofence run, not before it, so he was neither more than 300 m from the pin nor travelling at 15 km/h or above; his nearest approach across the trip is 22.4 m. Even if the clock were recomputed from the first qualifying fix, the corrected dwell of 620 seconds still exceeds the 480-second minimum, which is precisely the situation POL-NS-05(iii) covers - a false marker does not by itself defeat a fee whose corrected dwell was served.

    EV-GPS-00202, EV-TRIP-00202 · POL-NS-05, POL-NS-01

  5. POL-NS-06 does not apply.

    Read the whole claim

    The clause refunds only where the effective in-geofence dwell falls short of the free waiting period in force; here the measured run is 620 seconds against 480 seconds required, a surplus of 140 seconds (derived.arrival.shortfall_sec of -140.0 computed on longest_run_sec). There is no shortfall to refund, so the rider has no route to the fee through this clause.

    EV-GPS-00202 · POL-NS-06

  6. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because limb (a) fails at the first step.

    Read the whole claim

    Limb (a) requires a rider message during the waiting window whose content is locating or coordinating; the chat log for this trip contains exactly three messages and none is from the rider - MSG-00202-001 is the system 'Your driver has arrived' notice and MSG-00202-002 and MSG-00202-003 are the driver's own ('boss i'm at door 5 T3 arrival'; 'boss? still waiting ah'). With limb (a) failed the clause does not engage. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00202 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 on issue UNREAD_MESSAGE (all three messages carry read_at null); the impairment bears on whether the rider saw the messages, not on limb (a), which turns on the sender field alone, and no deciding fact of this case rests on this artifact.

    EV-CHAT-00202, EV-TRIP-00202 · POL-NS-04

  7. The rider's own track decides nothing, and its undecidability is neutral rather than adverse to the driver.

    Read the whole claim

    All 88 rider fixes report 45 m to 80 m horizontal accuracy - worse than the 25 m filter POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-04(c) share - so rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0. Under POL-NS-11, limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is UNDECIDABLE: neither satisfied nor failed, POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, the missing qualifying rider track does not impair the driver's arrival or dwell evidence, and the dispute is decided on the driver's own evidence. I do not assert that the rider was absent; the record does not say so, and the fee does not turn on it.

    EV-GPS-00202 · POL-NS-11, POL-NS-04

  8. No traffic advisory is asserted and none is needed.

    Read the whole claim

    EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 - no advisory covers the Changi Airport kerbside in this window - and its absence is citable as such. The driver does not claim an accumulation under POL-NS-06(i): the trace shows one unbroken in-geofence interval of 620 seconds, so no summing of separate intervals arises and no advisory is required to support the dwell that limb (c) of POL-NS-01 measures.

    EV-ADVIS-00202-01, EV-GPS-00202 · POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-00202-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

  9. POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so the driver is compensated at 80 percent of the fee in force - 80 percent of $6.00 is $4.80, which is the figure the fare breakdown itself derives. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4-or-more limb, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 168 is 0.006, far below the 0.08 rate limb; those are the only two profile fields the clause reads. I disclose that EV-DPROF-00202 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.9 on issue SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH (snapshot authored at schema 0.9.0); the issue is immaterial to these two counters, which sit an order of magnitude away from both thresholds, and the claim survives the discount.

    EV-DPROF-00202, EV-FARE-00202, EV-TRIP-00202 · POL-NS-07, POL-NS-01

  10. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so a monetary ruling is available and the fee need not be held for review.

    Read the whole claim

    There is no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts on arrival or dwell - the trip record's wait_time_min of 10.2 is consistent with the trace's 620-second run; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0; the anti-farming check does not trip; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 the clause requires; and the deciding facts are carried by COMPLETE artifacts at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap does not fall below the 0.70 floor.

    EV-GPS-00202, EV-TRIP-00202, EV-RPROF-00202, EV-DPROF-00202 · POL-NS-09, POL-GEN-02Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-DPROF-00202 at weight_multiplier 0.9 but does not name its issue code(s): SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH

Draft 1 - sampled
To the rider and to the driver: the $6.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00202 stands, and the driver is paid $4.80 of it. Here is why, and what it means for each of you. The fee is chargeable only if all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold. They do. (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 23:13:10 (EV-TRIP-00202). (b) The GPS trace places the driver inside the Changi Terminal 3 AIRPORT geofence before that event: the first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 23:12:45, 25 seconds earlier, on a trace with 100% coverage and no gaps (EV-GPS-00202). (c) The free waiting period in force for this trip is 480 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The driver held position inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius for one continuous qualifying run of 620 seconds, from 23:12:45 to 23:23:05, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as the clause directs - 140 seconds more than required. (d) No boarding event is recorded, and the driver terminated the trip at 23:23:20 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell elapsed at 23:20:45. platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies. The arrival marker was not false: at 23:13:10 the driver was already inside the geofence and stationary, so neither the 300 m nor the 15 km/h trigger of POL-NS-05 fires, and no false-arrival referral is produced. POL-NS-06 does not apply either, because there was no shortfall to refund. Rider, your account that your flight from Bangkok was delayed and that you were inside the terminal the whole time is not contradicted by anything in the record, and I accept that you did not see the messages before the cancellation. But the policy gives a refund on this ground only where you sent a locating or coordinating message during the waiting window and the driver did not answer it (POL-NS-04). No message in the chat log (EV-CHAT-00202) was sent by you - the three messages are the system arrival notice and the driver's two messages - so limb (a) of that clause fails at the first step and the clause cannot exonerate you. I also note that EV-CHAT-00202 is impaired at weight 0.85 (issue UNREAD_MESSAGE: all three messages carry read_at null), which confirms delivery only, not receipt; that impairment does not change the outcome, because limb (a) turns on the sender field alone and no deciding fact of this case rests on the chat log. Your own device track (all 88 fixes report 45-80 m accuracy and are filtered out) leaves your presence UNDECIDABLE rather than adverse to you, per POL-NS-04(c) and POL-NS-11; I make no finding that you were away from the pickup. Driver, your narrative that you waited and messaged is corroborated by the trace and the chat log, and the fee is not displaced by any clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06. Under POL-NS-07 you are paid 80% of the $6.00 fee in force, which is $4.80 - the same figure the fare breakdown derives (EV-FARE-00202). The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1/168 completed trips is 0.006 (below 0.08). EV-DPROF-00202 is impaired at weight 0.9 (SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH); the two counters it supplies for that check sit an order of magnitude below both thresholds, and the impairment does not change the result - it only caps my confidence at 0.90. I note EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0): no traffic advisory covers the kerbside in this window, and no accumulation of separate intervals under POL-NS-06(i) was asserted or needs to be. No escalation applies. There is no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts on arrival or dwell; the two counterparty-dispute counters are both 0; the anti-farming check does not trip and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1; and no deciding fact rests on an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d). Nothing in the record produces a clause-mandated referral, so the referrals list is empty. The monetary effect ($4.80) is below the $8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes on issue; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
Draft 2 - sampled
To the rider: the $6.00 no-show charge stands and is not refunded; the driver is paid $4.80 of it, and $1.20 is retained as the platform service fee. This is decided on the driver's own instrument records, not on any finding about where you were. Why the charge stands (POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02). The fee is chargeable only if all four limbs hold, and on EV-TRIP-00202 and EV-GPS-00202 they do. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 23:13:10. (b) The GPS trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 23:12:45, 25 seconds before that event, inside the 150 m Changi T3 AIRPORT arrival radius (POL-NS-02). (c) The driver then held position continuously inside that radius for 620 seconds, from 23:12:45 to 23:23:05, measured from the first qualifying fix as limb (c) directs, and the trace is 100% covered with no gaps; that is 140 seconds more than the 480-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 480). (d) The trip record shows no boarding and a termination by the driver at 23:23:20 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell elapsed at 23:20:45; platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is unset. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces this: the qualifying fixes are inside the arrival radius, so POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply; the arrival marker was not false, the driver being at his closest approach of 22.4 m and stationary at 23:13:10, so POL-NS-05 does not bite; and 620 seconds against 480 is a surplus, not a shortfall, so POL-NS-06 has nothing to refund. Your account, taken fully. (1) You say you were in the terminal the whole time. The GPS rider track cannot settle that either way: all 88 of your fixes report 45-80 m horizontal accuracy and are excluded by the 25 m filter, so under POL-NS-04(c) and POL-NS-11 your presence is UNDECIDABLE. I make no finding that you were elsewhere, and your device recording nothing admissible does not impair the driver's arrival or dwell. But your presence is not a condition of the fee, so this does not change the result. (2) You say you saw no messages until later. I accept that. The chat log EV-CHAT-00202 is impaired at weight 0.85 on issue UNREAD_MESSAGE: the system arrival notice at 23:13:11 and the driver's two messages at 23:14:02 and 23:19:30 were delivered but carry read_at null, so the record shows delivery, not receipt. But non-receipt does not exonerate you, because POL-NS-04 requires that YOU sent a locating or coordinating message that the driver then failed to answer within 120 seconds, and the log contains no message from you at all. POL-NS-06 states in terms that the fee turns on the driver's waiting time, not on whether the rider responded. (3) You did not press a dwell or a false-arrival attack, and rightly so on this arithmetic. The driver's compensation (POL-NS-07). Compensation is 80% of the fee in force: 80% of $6.00 = $4.80, the same figure the fare breakdown EV-FARE-00202 derives. The anti-farming check reads only driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d (1, below 4) and completed_trips_30d (168, giving 1/168 = 0.006, below 0.08), so it does not trip and the payout is made. EV-DPROF-00202 is impaired at weight 0.90 on issue SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH; that impairment is immaterial to those two counters, which sit far from both thresholds, and the finding survives the discount (POL-GEN-02(3)). No profile field outside the citable counters was used (POL-GEN-01). Confidence. The deciding facts of the charge and the payout are carried by the GPS trace (1.00), the trip record (1.00) and the fare breakdown (1.00); the lowest-weight artifact any part of this ruling rests on is the driver profile at 0.90, used only for the anti-farming check, so the cap is 0.90. That is above the 0.70 floor, so no escalation arises; the chat log's 0.85 bears only on receipt, which carries no deciding fact. The monetary effect is $4.80, below the $8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so it executes automatically. The driver's claim about the MISSING traffic advisory and the driver's claim that no POL-NS-09 trigger fires were discarded by the referee for citing impaired artifacts without naming their issue codes, and I do not rely on either. This ruling was made without human review and is provisional; either party may appeal within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
Draft 3 - sampled
To the rider and to the driver: the $6.00 Changi Airport no-show fee stands, and the driver is paid $4.80 of it (80% of the fee in force, platform-funded under POL-NS-07); the platform keeps the remaining $1.20 as its service fee. On a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling the amount_sgd figure is the same $4.80 - it is the money the ruling moves, not a second payment and not a refund to the filing party, whose charge stands. Why the fee stands (rider). POL-NS-01 is a four-limb test on the driver's own telemetry and all four limbs hold. (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 23:13:10. (b) The GPS trace EV-GPS-00202 (COMPLETE, weight 1.0) places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius from 23:12:45, 25 seconds before that event, his nearest approach being 22.4 m from the pin. (c) That in-geofence run was continuous for 620 seconds against the 480-second free waiting period in force for this airport trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 480; POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the arrival tap), a surplus of 140 seconds. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 23:23:20 under RIDER_NO_SHOW - a code limb (d) recognises - which is 155 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 23:20:45, and the record carries no boarding event. platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies. No refund route is open on these facts. POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) is not engaged: at the 23:13:10 marker the driver was inside the geofence and stationary, not more than 300 m out and not travelling at 15 km/h. POL-NS-06 (premature cancellation) is not engaged: there is no shortfall to refund. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) is not engaged: the stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius, not outside it within 400 m. POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered) fails at its first limb (a): the chat log EV-CHAT-00202 contains no message from the rider at all - its three messages are the system arrival notice and two driver messages - so the clause never engages and I do not reach limbs (b) or (c). On the rider's remaining points. Your account that you were in the terminal the whole time is not something the charge turns on: the chargeable no-show test asks about the driver's conduct, and the rider position track (all 88 fixes reporting 45-80 m accuracy, excluded by the same 25 m filter) is undecidable rather than adverse - I neither find you were at the pin nor that you were away from it (POL-NS-11). The two driver messages and the arrival notice were delivered but never read (read_at null), which explains why you saw them late; it does not undo a correctly measured wait. The undecidable rider track and your unrebutted narrative are therefore accepted but do not move the fee. On the driver's $4.80 (driver). POL-NS-07 fixes the payout at 80% of the $6.00 fee in force = $4.80, the figure the fare breakdown itself derives. The anti-farming guard does not fire: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below the threshold of 4) and 1 divided by 168 completed trips is 0.006 (below the 0.08 rate). Impairments disclosed (POL-GEN-02(3)). EV-CHAT-00202, weight 0.85, issue UNREAD_MESSAGE - it shows delivery, not receipt, and carries no deciding fact. EV-DPROF-00202, weight 0.9, issue SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH - immaterial, because the two counters it is read for sit an order of magnitude clear of both thresholds, so the compensation finding survives the discount. EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0: no traffic advisory covers this kerbside, so the accumulation route in POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable and the driver does not claim it. The deciding facts - arrival, dwell, termination and the fee - rest on COMPLETE artifacts at weight 1.0 (EV-GPS-00202, EV-TRIP-00202, EV-FARE-00202), so confidence is not capped below 0.90 and stays above the 0.70 floor. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires: no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or presence; the trailing-90-day counterparty dispute counts are both 0; the anti-farming check does not trip; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1; and the deciding evidence is unimpaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d). No clause produces a referral. The monetary effect of $4.80 is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00 and executes automatically, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.
Draft 4 - parties' positions swapped
To the rider: the $6.00 cancellation fee stands and is not refunded. To the driver: the fee is upheld and your payout is fixed at $4.80. The verified no-show test of POL-NS-01 is met in full. (a) EV-TRIP-00202 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-07-24T23:13:10. (b) EV-GPS-00202 places the driver inside the AIRPORT pickup geofence (150 m radius under POL-NS-02) from the first qualifying fix at 23:12:45 — 25 seconds before the marker, and the nearest approach across the trip is 22.4 m. (c) The same trace shows one unbroken in-geofence run of 620 seconds (63 qualifying fixes, 23:12:45 to 23:23:05) against the 480-second free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-00202.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 480, matching the AIRPORT minimum in the fee schedule). Measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, as limb (c) directs, the required dwell was served with 140 seconds to spare. (d) The record shows no boarding and a driver termination at 23:23:20 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed at 23:20:45. I have run every clause that could displace the fee and none does. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes are inside the 150 m radius, not in the outside-but-within-400 m band. POL-NS-05 does not apply: at the 23:13:10 marker the driver was inside the geofence and stationary, neither more than 300 m out nor at 15 km/h or above, so the marker is not false. POL-NS-06 does not apply: 620 seconds exceeds 480, a surplus of 140 seconds (derived shortfall_sec -140.0), not a shortfall. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider because limb (a) fails at the first step: EV-CHAT-00202 contains no rider message at all — its three messages are the system arrival notice and two driver messages. Two artifacts sit below full weight and I name them as POL-GEN-02(3) requires. EV-CHAT-00202 weighs 0.85 (issue UNREAD_MESSAGE): every message carries read_at null, so it proves delivery, not receipt. That supports the rider's account that he did not see the messages and I accept he was in the terminal, but it does not disturb the no-show finding, which rests on the driver's GPS position and not on the chat. EV-DPROF-00202 weighs 0.9 (issue SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH): the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip on either limb (no_show_terminations_30d 1, below 4; 1/168 = 0.006, below 0.08), and those counters sit an order of magnitude from the thresholds, so the discount is immaterial and the finding survives it. On the rider's own position, EV-GPS-00202's rider track is present but every fix reports 45–80 m accuracy and is filtered out by the 25 m test, leaving rider_qualifying_fix_count at 0; under POL-NS-11 and POL-NS-04 limb (c) that makes rider presence undecidable rather than failed, and I make no finding that the rider was elsewhere — but neutrality does not exonerate, because POL-NS-04 fails on limb (a) regardless. No escalation applies: confidence 0.90 is above the 0.70 floor (POL-NS-09(a)); no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or presence; the shared-dispute and no_show_disputes_30d counters are 0 and 1; the anti-farming check is clear; and the deciding facts are carried by COMPLETE artifacts at weight 1.0. No clause produces a referral. POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's compensation at 80 percent of the $6.00 fee in force = $4.80 (the figure EV-FARE-00202 itself derives), the rider's $6.00 charge standing. The monetary effect is $4.80, at or below the $8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so it executes on issue.
